turns.text: And hopefully, you'll be able to express yourself more clearly, more accurately, and more closely to how you really feel about these subjects.
turns.zh: 而且希望你能更清楚、更准确地表达自己，更贴近你对这些话题的真实感受。

turns.text: And remember, we've got a free PDF for you to download down below with the dictionary and all of those difficult words and phrases.
turns.zh: 还有，记得我们下面有一个免费的PDF可以下载，里面有词典和所有那些难词难句。

turns.text: It should be interesting for you to look through these after you've done some listening.
turns.zh: 你听完之后翻一翻这些，应该会挺有意思的。

turns.text: And then maybe you can listen again, and that will kind of help really solidify some of those vocabulary phrases.
turns.zh: 然后也许你可以再听一遍，那样能帮你真正巩固那些词汇短语。

turns.text: Yeah, and lastly, what do you think?
Would you say that you're in control of your screen time?
turns.zh: 你会说自己能控制好屏幕使用时间吗？

turns.text: We'd love to hear your thoughts, opinions, and also help you out if you have any English questions as well.
turns.zh: 我们很想听听你的想法、观点，如果你有英语问题，我们也很乐意帮你。

turns.text: Don't forget to like and subscribe, and chat with us in the comments below.
turns.zh: 别忘了点赞订阅，在下面评论区跟我们聊聊。
